PaymentService.//BaseUrl: Internal URL of PaymentService. Empty disables online payments everywhere: no store can switch them on.
PaymentService.//CallbackSecret: Must match Payments:Callbacks:SigningSecret in PaymentService. Empty accepts callbacks unsigned, which is only safe on a private network.
PaymentService.//CallbackBaseUrl: Public origin of THIS api, so PaymentService knows where to post. Falls back to the incoming request's origin.

Console.//Url: Public origin of the staff console; order alerts link back to it.

Telegram.//BotToken: From BotFather. Keep it in user-secrets or an environment variable. Empty (or no BotUsername) turns order alerts off.
Telegram.//PollingEnabled: Receives /start via long polling. Only one instance per bot may poll; set false on the others.
